image_description: A close-up photograph of a vintage comic book cover titled 'Spectacular Spider-Man'. The cover features a central illustration of a yellow and orange robotic or alien creature with multiple limbs and red eyes, set against a dark, textured background. The top displays the title in bold, stylized lettering. The left spine area contains vertical text and barcode-like elements. The bottom right includes a small inset panel and price box. The image exhibits signs of age, such as slight wear and color fading.

artifact_observations.location: Left spine text and bottom caption boxes
artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical text on the left spine is nonsensical and malformed, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than legible letters. The small text in the bottom inset is also blurred and illegible, lacking clear character structure.

The texture of the yellow/orange creature is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine line work or halftone dots typically seen in printed comic art. It looks more like a 3D render pasted onto a 2D background.

The lower appendages of the central figure merge into each other and the background in a physically ambiguous way. It is unclear how many limbs there are or how they connect to the torso, suggesting minor structural fusion.
The title text 'SPECTACULAR SPIDER-MAN' follows the perspective of the cover but the letters themselves are slightly warped and unevenly spaced, inconsistent with standard typographic kerning.
